description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Header' that manages user authentication state, displays user info, and provides a dropdown menu with options like 'settings' and 'logout'. It uses Material-UI components for UI elements and interacts with Redux, React Router, and localStorage.

classes.name: useStyles
classes.description: A hook created with Material-UI's makeStyles to generate CSS classes for styling the component.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: React functional component that renders the header bar with user info and menu options, manages user authentication state, and handles navigation and logout.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Dispatches a logout action, redirects to home, and clears user state.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the user menu popper.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the user menu popper when clicking outside.

methods.name: openLink
methods.description: Navigates to a specified link and closes the menu.

methods.name: handleListKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the menu, specifically the Tab key.
